generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: States the unmet need, technical bottleneck, missing capability, unserved user, or unexploited combination that makes the idea actionable.

contract.purpose_user_function: Express the candidate’s evidence-backed gap or unmet technical need through its title, hypothesis, approach, novelty hypothesis, and origin evidence.
contract.valid_inputs: Idea sources, evidence gaps, methods/claims, candidate text, origin evidence, and novelty context.
contract.expected_outputs: A candidate statement that makes the technical opportunity and proposed response recognizable.
contract.state_side_effects: Persists the opportunity framing inside idea candidate artifacts and passes it to screening.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Candidate remains blocked/inconclusive when no distinct gap/value or evidence-grounded hypothesis can be formed.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Technical gap/opportunity framing is present, but unmet user, missing capability, and actionability are not separate typed fields.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/plugins/autosci/backends/idea_source.py::build_idea_candidates` creates gap/method/combination candidates and `idea_candidate.v1.schema.json` captures their core framing.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test unmet need, technical bottleneck, missing capability, unserved user, unexploited combination, no-actionable-gap, and multi-opportunity split.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/ideate`, `/novelty`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: skills/ideate/SKILL.md; skills/novelty/SKILL.md; harness/plugins/autosci/bin/autosci_bridge.py idea and novelty actions
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Final novelty promotion requires external evidence or Review LLM availability; offline/local overlap is only a surrogate. Strategic and portfolio criteria are not fully modeled.
